title: Analyzing Dataset Annotation Quality Management in the Wild

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying the representativeness of the Papers With Code (PwC) database by annotating a random subset of 500 papers from the ACL anthology to measure biases related to dataset quality, publication time, dataset popularity, availability, and domain.

Surveying 591 dataset-introducing publications to evaluate the prevalence of quality management practices, such as inter-annotator agreement and probabilistic aggregation (e.g., Dawid-Skene, MACE), which are used to model and mitigate subjective annotator bias and systematic labeling errors.
